prompt: I'm preparing slides for a talk on host-pathogen interactions. Make me a publication-quality 2D figure of the SARS-CoV-2 RBD in complex with human ACE2 (PDB entry 6MRR): the hand-drawn Richardson-style cartoon look, each chain in a different color. I need a transparent 300-dpi PNG I can drop onto a slide, plus an SVG version of the same figure.
assertions: A PNG deliverable exists and is at least 2000x2000 pixels (300-dpi render scale)
The PNG has an alpha channel (RGBA), i.e. transparent background
An SVG deliverable exists and is non-trivial (>10 KB of vector content)
The figure depicts 6MRR as a secondary-structure cartoon (ribbon helices / arrowed strands), not a plain backbone line trace
The two chains (RBD and ACE2) are visibly distinguished by different colors
